section.title: Version author
section.subtitle: Your name and e-mail sign every project version. Colleagues will see them in the history once you connect a repository.
section.loadFailed: Could not load the version author.
section.resetConfirm: New versions will be signed with the shared Studio signature again. Earlier versions keep their author. Continue?
section.resetFailed: Could not go back to the shared signature.

form.name: Name
form.noreplyHint: If GitHub hides your e-mail, take the address like 123456+name@users.noreply.github.com from its settings.
form.preview: This is how a version will be signed
form.privacy: Your name and e-mail go into the version history and are visible to everyone with access to the repository. Earlier versions keep their previous author.
form.defaultNotice: Versions are currently signed with the shared Studio signature: {{author}}. Enter your name and e-mail so colleagues can recognise your edits.
form.saveFailed: Could not save the author. Please try again.

validation.name_required: Enter your name so colleagues can recognise you.
validation.name_too_long: The name is too long: 128 characters at most.
validation.name_invalid: The name cannot contain < or >, and punctuation alone is not enough.
validation.email_too_long: The address is too long: 254 characters at most.

dialog.title: Introduce yourself
dialog.description: The Studio needs your name and e-mail: they sign the versions that go to the repository.

reason.connect: To connect a repository the Studio needs your name and e-mail: they sign the versions that go to the server.
reason.sync: To sync the project the Studio needs your name and e-mail: they sign the versions that go to the repository.
reason.clone: To download a project from a repository the Studio needs your name and e-mail: they sign your future versions.
